property_summary: Calling transfer returns true iff it completes all low-level calls successfully (no internal call failed); if any low-level call reverts, transfer itself reverts.
If transfer returns (doesn't revert) then it must return true (i.e., it never completes and returns false) for valid contract_address and matching non-empty arrays.
When transfer is called with valid contract_address and matching non-empty arrays, it either reverts or returns true (i.e., it never returns false).
